schema_sql: CREATE TABLE customer(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, c_id BIGINT NOT NULL, balance BIGINT NOT NULL, ytd_payment BIGINT NOT NULL, payment_count BIGINT NOT NULL, delivery_count BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, d_id, c_id));
CREATE TABLE district(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, ytd BIGINT NOT NULL, next_o_id BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, d_id));
CREATE TABLE history(h_id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, c_w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, c_d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, c_id BIGINT NOT NULL, amount BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE item(i_id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, price BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE new_order(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, o_id BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, d_id, o_id));

CREATE TABLE order_line(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, o_id BIGINT NOT NULL, number BIGINT NOT NULL, i_id BIGINT NOT NULL, supply_w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, amount BIGINT NOT NULL, delivered BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, d_id, o_id, number));

CREATE TABLE orders(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, d_id BIGINT NOT NULL, o_id BIGINT NOT NULL, c_id BIGINT NOT NULL, carrier_id BIGINT, line_count BIGINT NOT NULL, total BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, d_id, o_id));
CREATE TABLE stock(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL, i_id BIGINT NOT NULL, quantity BIGINT NOT NULL, ytd BIGINT NOT NULL, order_count BIGINT NOT NULL, remote_count BIGINT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(w_id, i_id));
CREATE TABLE warehouse(w_id BIGINT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, ytd BIGINT NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX orders_customer ON orders(w_id, d_id, c_id, o_id);

method: serial canonical SQL replay; all values independently fingerprinted after reopen and maintenance; SlopDB L6-only full rewrite
durability: WAL enabled; fsync disabled for WAL; SQLite synchronous=OFF also disables data/checkpoint sync; SlopDB/DuckDB data/checkpoint sync enabled
